content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC (Know Your Customer) payment gateway is a revolutionary alternative to traditional payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. By leveraging blockchain technology, these gateways enable digital sellers to accept cryptocurrency payments directly from customers, bypassing the need for intermediaries and associated fees. This means you can sell ebooks, courses, or digital downloads without depending on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, and retain 99.5% of your revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC payment gateway is built around Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle backend logic and automate delivery of digital products. NOWPayments, a leading cryptocurrency payment processor, is integrated with the gateway to facilitate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. When a customer makes a payment, the transaction is verified on-chain, and the digital product is delivered instantly. This process eliminates the need for manual intervention and reduces the risk of payment disputes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital sellers who operate in countries with restricted payment gateways or those who want to reduce their reliance on intermediaries. By using a no-KYC payment gateway, you can break free from the limitations of traditional payment processors and focus on growing your business. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, worth $348 separately.
No-KYC payment gateways eliminate the need for manual intervention and reduce payment disputes.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a no-KYC payment gateway, follow these steps: (1) choose a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages; (2) set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic; (3) integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; (4) configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; and (5) deploy your digital products using the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.

Frequently Asked Questions
How does NOWPayments handle payment disputes?
NOWPayments uses blockchain technology to verify transactions on-chain, reducing the risk of payment disputes. In case of a dispute, you can contact NOWPayments support for assistance.
Can I use a no-KYC payment gateway with multiple payment methods?
Yes, you can integrate multiple payment methods, including cryptocurrency and fiat currency, using NOWPayments.
How does a no-KYC payment gateway reduce fees?
By bypassing traditional payment processors like Stripe or PayPal, you can retain 99.5% of your revenue, compared to 90% with Gumroad's 10% fee.
Can I use a no-KYC payment gateway with my existing website?
Yes, you can integrate a no-KYC payment gateway with your existing website using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
How does a no-KYC payment gateway improve customer experience?
By providing a seamless payment experience, you can improve customer satisfaction and increase sales revenue.
